name: Residence Permit (Dependant)

requirement_groups.name: Spouse of an expatriate or a Ghanaian who holds a foreign passport

requirements.blocker_text: Must have been married for more than 4 years to qualify as a dependant spouse.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married for more than 4 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a parental consent letter and the child's birth certificate; a court-issued statutory declaration from the guardian is required where applicable.

evidence_required.document: Signed bond form at the nearest Immigration Office

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source located in this build; tied to the principal's residence status

sources.title: Ghana Immigration Service -- Residence Permit (Dependant): for dependants of expatriates and Ghanaian nationals who hold foreign passports, including spouses, children, and other dependants; spouses must have been married more than 4 years; requires bank statements/indenture, parental consent letter and birth certificate (children), court statutory declaration from guardian where applicable, two Ghanaian guarantors, signed bond form

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ghana). Published on tier-1 sourcing (Ghana Immigration Service). DISTINCTIVE, PRECISE FIGURE: a 4-year-plus marriage duration requirement for the spousal Dependant Permit itself -- an unusually specific and long threshold for what is normally a fast, low-barrier accompanying-spouse permit in most other countries built in this dataset (contrast e.g. India's X-visa, available immediately on marriage with no waiting period). This is distinct from gh_citizenship_by_marriage.json (actual citizenship via marriage, a separate and even more demanding process).
